SELECT 
  a.city_id,
  c.city,
  COUNT(*) as address_count,
  COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 FROM address) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city_id) * 1.0 FROM address) as ratio_to_avg,
  COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 FROM address) as share_of_all
FROM address a
JOIN city c ON a.city_id = c.city_id
GROUP BY a.city_id, c.city
ORDER BY share_of_all DESC, a.city_id ASC
LIMIT 10
